question_text: A 23-year-old woman with asthma is brought to the emergency department because of shortness of breath and wheezing for 20 minutes. She is unable to speak more than a few words at a time. Her pulse is 116/min and respirations are 28/min. Pulse oximetry on room air shows an oxygen saturation of 92%. Examination of the lungs shows decreased breath sounds and scattered end-expiratory wheezing over all lung fields. Treatment with high-dose continuous inhaled albuterol is begun. This patient is at increased risk for which of the following adverse effects?
